what: checklist E3: scripts/backtest_xsec_momentum.py was wired to execution_costs for SLIPPAGE (via the same per-rebalance turnover-cost mechanism as its existing fee), but FUNDING was deliberately left unwired. The harness holds WEIGHTS across a multi-symbol universe with rebalance-to-rebalance bookkeeping, not per-position entry/exit Trade objects, so there is no clean per-leg hold-duration to charge execution_costs' funding-window drag against. The book trades a crypto-perp universe (per its own docstring: "crypto long/short, dollar-neutral"), so funding IS a real, currently-unpriced cost. Needs either (a) a per-symbol position-duration tracker between rebalances so funding windows crossed can be computed per leg, or (b) an explicit, documented decision that funding is out of scope for this harness with a stated reason beyond "not yet built".
